rv.q: Monumental Theatre has ably mounted Richard O'Brien's rock and roll musical with a superior 5-piece combo, outstanding lighting and choreography, and several strong performances.
Monumental’s immersive stage production is wholeheartedly energetic in a way that the movie sometimes just isn’t.
The show boasts many other qualities in living up to the co-directors' stated aim for "something sexy, immersive, goofy, gay, and, above all, fun!"
Monumental is back with a disruptively fun ride via their novel take on a camp classic.

cn.t: Monumental Theatre delivers an energetic and entertaining production that accentuates the musical's lustful spirit while mixing familiar elements with unexpected touches in an immersive, cabaret-style staging.
